instructions: Face anchor leaning back at 45 degrees
Arms extended at chest height
Pull body up keeping elbows at sides
Squeeze shoulder blades at top

name: TRX Low Row
instructions: Face anchor in nearly horizontal position
Arms extended toward anchor
Pull body up bringing hands to waist
Lower with control

name: TRX Power Pull
instructions: Hold one handle with one hand
Lean back with free arm reaching toward anchor
Explosively pull body up rotating torso
Reach free arm back and repeat

name: TRX Y Fly
instructions: Face anchor leaning back
Pull body up while extending arms in Y shape
Arms finish overhead and wide
Lower with control

name: TRX T Fly
instructions: Face anchor leaning back
Pull body up extending arms to sides in T
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Lower with control

name: TRX I Fly
instructions: Face anchor leaning back
Pull body up extending arms straight overhead
Keep arms close to ears at top
Lower with control

name: TRX W Fly
instructions: Face anchor leaning back
Pull body up bending elbows to form W
Upper arms parallel to ground at top
Lower with control

name: TRX Biceps Curl
instructions: Face anchor leaning back with palms up
Arms extended at shoulder height
Curl body up by bending elbows
Keep elbows high throughout

name: TRX Inverted Row
instructions: Lie under TRX with handles above chest
Grab handles and extend body nearly horizontal
Pull chest up to handles
Lower with control

name: TRX Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie on back with heels in TRX straps
Lift hips off ground to form bridge
Curl heels toward glutes
Extend legs and repeat

name: TRX Hip Press
instructions: Lie on back with heels in TRX straps
Drive through heels to lift hips
Form straight line from shoulders to knees
Lower with control

name: TRX Single Leg Hip Press
instructions: Lie on back with one heel in strap
Extend free leg toward ceiling
Drive through heel to lift hips
Lower with control and repeat

name: TRX Torso Rotation
instructions: Face anchor holding handles with arms extended
Lean back slightly and rotate torso to one side
Keep arms extended and hips square
Rotate to other side

name: TRX Side Plank
instructions: Place feet in straps and assume side plank
Stack feet or stagger for balance
Keep body in straight line
Hold for desired duration then switch sides

name: TRX Crunch
instructions: Start in TRX plank with feet in straps
Drive both knees toward chest
Keep shoulders stable over hands
Extend legs back to plank

name: TRX Oblique Crunch
instructions: Start in TRX plank with feet in straps
Drive knees toward one elbow
Return to plank and repeat to other side
Keep upper body stable

name: TRX Atomic Pushup
instructions: Place your feet in TRX straps and assume a pushup position with hands on the ground
Perform a full pushup by lowering your chest to the ground and pressing back up
At the top of the pushup, draw your knees toward your chest in a tuck motion
Extend your legs back to the starting position with control
Repeat the sequence of pushup followed by knee tuck for desired reps

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Stand holding end of barbell at shoulder height
Brace core and press bar up and forward
Extend arm fully at top
Lower with control and repeat

name: Landmine Single Arm Press
instructions: Hold barbell end with one hand at shoulder
Press up and forward while rotating slightly
Control the descent
Complete reps then switch arms

name: Landmine Half Kneeling Press
instructions: Kneel with one knee down holding barbell
Press bar up and forward from shoulder
Maintain tall torso throughout
Switch sides after completing reps

name: Landmine Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor holding barbell end over chest
Lower elbow to floor
Press bar back up
Keep core braced throughout

name: Landmine Meadows Row
instructions: Stand perpendicular to barbell in staggered stance
Hinge at hips and grab bar end with outside hand
Row bar to hip keeping elbow close
Lower and repeat, then switch sides

name: Landmine T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle barbell facing anchor point
Hinge forward and grab bar with both hands
Row bar to chest squeezing shoulder blades
Lower with control

name: Landmine Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold barbell end at chest like goblet
Squat down keeping chest up
Drive through heels to stand
Keep elbows close to body

name: Landmine Cossack Squat
instructions: Hold barbell at chest standing wide
Shift weight to one leg and squat
Keep other leg straight with toe up
Push back to center and alternate

name: Landmine Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulder height
Step back into reverse lunge
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Drive through front heel to return

name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold barbell end with both hands
Hinge at hips pushing butt back
Lower bar while keeping back flat
Drive hips forward to stand

name: Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold barbell in one hand
Balance on same-side leg
Hinge forward extending free leg back
Return to standing

name: Landmine Rotation
instructions: Hold barbell with both hands extended
Rotate bar from one hip to overhead on opposite side
Control the arc of movement
Reverse and repeat

name: Landmine Kneeling Core Rotation
instructions: Kneel holding barbell extended in front
Rotate bar to one side keeping arms extended
Core stays tight, hips stay square
Rotate to other side

name: Landmine Thruster
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulder in front rack
Squat down with chest up
Drive up and press bar overhead
Lower bar to shoulder and repeat

name: Landmine Push Press
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulder
Dip knees slightly
Explosively extend legs while pressing bar
Lower and repeat

name: Ring Push Up
instructions: Set rings to low height
Grip rings and assume pushup position
Lower chest between rings with control
Press up while stabilizing rings

name: Ring Dip
instructions: Grip rings and lift body to support hold
Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees
Keep rings close to body
Press back up to support

name: Ring Support Hold
instructions: Grip rings and press up to straight arm support
Turn rings out slightly for stability
Hold position with body straight
Maintain for desired duration

name: Ring Row
instructions: Set rings at waist height
Grip rings and lean back with straight body
Pull chest to rings squeezing shoulder blades
Lower with control

name: Ring Face Pull
instructions: Set rings at face height
Lean back holding rings with arms extended
Pull rings to face with elbows high
Lower with control

name: Ring Muscle Up
instructions: Grip rings and hang with arms extended
Pull explosively while leaning forward
Transition through dip position
Press to support hold at top

name: Ring L-Sit
instructions: Grip rings in support position
Lift legs in front to horizontal
Keep legs straight and together
Hold for desired duration

name: Ring Tuck Front Lever
instructions: Hang from gymnastics rings with a shoulder-width grip
Pull your body up slightly and lean back until arms are at your sides
Tuck your knees tightly to your chest while holding the lever position
Hold this position with your body parallel to the ground and arms straight
Lower back down with control and repeat for desired reps

name: Ring Tuck Back Lever
instructions: Start in inverted hang
Lower body backward with knees tucked
Hold body horizontal behind rings
Maintain position with control

name: Ring Iron Cross Hold
instructions: From support, slowly lower body while extending arms
Arms horizontal and parallel to ground
Hold position briefly
Advanced: Hold for longer durations

name: Ring Archer Row
instructions: Set rings at chest height
Pull with one arm while other extends out
Rotate body slightly toward working arm
Alternate sides

name: Ring Pike Push Up
instructions: Set rings low to the ground and grip them in a pike position with hips high
Keep your legs straight and hips elevated throughout the movement
Lower your head between the rings by bending your elbows
Press back up to the starting pike position with control
Maintain core tension and repeat for desired reps

name: Ring Fly
instructions: Set rings low and assume pushup position
Lower body while opening arms wide
Keep slight elbow bend
Squeeze chest to return to start

name: Ring Rollout
instructions: Kneel holding rings in front
Roll rings forward extending body
Keep core tight and back flat
Pull rings back to kneeling

name: Ring Tricep Extension
instructions: Set rings at forehead height
Grip rings and lean forward
Lower head through rings bending elbows
Extend elbows to press back

name: Ring Bicep Curl
instructions: Set rings at shoulder height
Lean back holding rings with palms up
Curl body toward rings bending elbows
Lower with control

name: Ring Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot in ring behind
Lower into single-leg squat
Keep front knee over ankle
Drive through heel to stand

name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Start with kettlebell between legs in hinge position
Explosively drive hips forward swinging bell up
Punch hand through at top to lockout overhead
Lower with control and repeat

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Start with kettlebell between legs
Swing bell up by driving hips
Catch in rack position at shoulder
Lower and repeat

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
instructions: Clean kettlebell to rack position
Press overhead to lockout
Lower to rack then swing back down
Repeat for reps

name: Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
instructions: Clean kettlebell to rack
Dip and drive kettlebell overhead
Lock out with slight knee bend
Lower to rack and repeat

name: Kettlebell Halo
instructions: Hold kettlebell upside down at chest
Circle bell around head in one direction
Keep elbows close and core tight
Reverse direction after reps

name: Kettlebell Around the World
instructions: Hold kettlebell in front of body
Pass bell around body hand to hand
Keep core tight and hips stable
Reverse direction after reps

name: Kettlebell High Pull
instructions: Start with bell between legs
Drive hips and pull bell to chin level
Keep elbow high at top
Lower and repeat

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with wide stance over kettlebell
Grip handle with both hands
Drive through heels to stand up
Lower with control

name: Kettlebell Overhead Squat
instructions: Press kettlebell overhead with one arm
Squat down while keeping arm locked out
Maintain upright torso
Stand up keeping bell overhead

name: Kettlebell Renegade Row
instructions: Get in pushup position with hands on kettlebells
Row one kettlebell to hip while stabilizing
Lower and row other side
Keep hips level throughout

name: Kettlebell Push Press
instructions: Hold kettlebells in rack position
Dip knees slightly
Explosively extend legs while pressing
Lower to rack with control

name: Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor holding kettlebells over chest
Lower elbows to floor
Press bells back up
Keep core engaged throughout

name: Kettlebell Farmers Walk
instructions: Hold kettlebells at sides
Walk forward with controlled steps
Keep shoulders back and core tight
Continue for desired distance

name: Kettlebell Waiters Walk
instructions: Hold kettlebell overhead with one arm
Walk forward maintaining overhead lockout
Keep shoulder packed down
Switch sides after distance

name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Press
instructions: Clean kettlebell to rack with bottom facing up
Press overhead while keeping bell balanced
Control the instability throughout
Lower to rack position

name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Carry
instructions: Hold kettlebell at shoulder with bottom up
Walk forward maintaining balanced position
Keep wrist straight and core tight
Switch sides after distance

name: Kettlebell Slingshot
instructions: Stand holding kettlebell in front
Pass bell behind back hand to hand
Circle back to front completing revolution
Alternate directions

name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
instructions: Start with kettlebell on ground
Clean to rack position from dead stop
Return to ground for each rep
Maintain good hip hinge mechanics

name: Kettlebell Swing to Squat
instructions: Perform kettlebell swing
As bell comes up, catch in goblet position
Immediately squat down
Stand and swing bell back through legs

name: Kettlebell Deck Squat
instructions: Hold kettlebell at chest
Roll backward onto back
Roll forward using momentum to stand
Immediately squat down and repeat

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing
instructions: Hold kettlebell with one hand
Swing bell between legs with hip hinge
Drive hips forward swinging to chest height
Control descent and repeat

name: Kettlebell Alternating Swing
instructions: Start with two-hand swing
At top, release one hand and switch grip
Continue swinging alternating hands
Maintain hip drive throughout

name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Hold band at shoulder width with arms extended
Pull hands apart stretching band across chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together at end
Return with control

name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor band at face height
Hold ends and step back for tension
Pull band to face with elbows high
Squeeze shoulder blades at end

name: Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on band with feet hip width
Hold handles at shoulders
Press overhead until arms fully extended
Lower with control

name: Band Lateral Walk
instructions: Place band around legs above knees
Bend knees slightly in athletic stance
Step sideways maintaining tension on band
Complete steps then reverse direction

name: Band Monster Walk
instructions: Place band around ankles
Bend knees in quarter squat position
Walk forward taking diagonal steps
Maintain constant tension on band

name: Band Clamshell
instructions: Lie on side with band around knees
Stack hips and bend knees 90 degrees
Keeping feet together, raise top knee
Lower with control and repeat

name: Band Good Morning
instructions: Stand on band holding behind neck
Hinge at hips pushing butt back
Lower torso to near parallel
Drive hips forward to stand

name: Band Deadlift
instructions: Stand on band with feet hip width
Hold band with both hands at thighs
Hinge at hips lowering hands toward floor
Drive through heels to stand

name: Band Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on band holding handles at hips
Keep legs nearly straight with soft knee bend
Hinge forward lowering hands
Drive hips forward to return

name: Band Front Squat
instructions: Stand on band holding at shoulders front rack style
Squat down with elbows high
Drive through heels to stand
Maintain upright torso throughout

name: Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor band behind back or wrap around back
Hold handles at chest level
Press forward until arms extended
Return with control

name: Band Chest Fly
instructions: Anchor band behind at chest height
Hold handles with arms extended to sides
Bring hands together in front of chest
Return with control

name: Band Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Anchor band overhead
Hold with elbows at sides bent 90 degrees
Extend elbows pressing hands down
Return with control

name: Band Tricep Kickback
instructions: Stand on band in staggered stance
Hinge forward holding band with elbow high
Extend elbow pressing hand back
Return and repeat

name: Band Curl
instructions: Stand on band with feet hip width
Hold handles with palms up
Curl hands toward shoulders
Lower with control

name: Band Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand on band with feet hip width
Hold handles with neutral grip
Curl hands toward shoulders
Lower with control

name: Band Upright Row
instructions: Stand on band with narrow stance
Hold handles at thighs
Pull up along body to chin level
Lower with control

name: Band Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand on band with feet hip width
Hinge forward holding handles
Row handles to sides of ribs
Lower with control

name: Band Seated Row
instructions: Sit with legs extended, band around feet
Hold handles with arms extended
Pull handles to sides of ribs
Extend arms with control

name: Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor band overhead
Kneel or stand holding handles overhead
Pull hands down to shoulder level
Return with control

name: Band Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with band around thighs
Feet flat on floor hip width apart
Drive through heels to lift hips
Squeeze glutes at top against band resistance

name: Band Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with back against bench, band over hips
Anchor band under feet or to fixed point
Drive through heels to lift hips
Squeeze glutes at top

name: Band Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor band at chest height to side
Hold band at chest with tension
Press hands straight out in front
Resist rotation and return to chest

name: Band Anti-Rotation Hold
instructions: Anchor band at chest height
Hold band with arms extended perpendicular to anchor
Resist rotation holding position
Switch sides after duration

name: Band Woodchop
instructions: Anchor band low to one side
Hold with both hands at hip level
Rotate and pull band diagonally across body
Control return and repeat

name: Band Reverse Woodchop
instructions: Anchor band high to one side
Hold with both hands at shoulder level
Rotate and pull band diagonally down across body
Control return and repeat

name: Band Leg Press
instructions: Lie on back holding band
Place feet in band loop
Press feet away extending legs
Bend knees to return

name: Band Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with band around ankle
Anchor other end to fixed point
Curl heel toward glutes
Lower with control

name: Band Terminal Knee Extension
instructions: Anchor band behind knee while standing
Start with slight knee bend
Extend knee fully against resistance
Bend knee with control

name: Band External Rotation
instructions: Hold band at elbow with arm at side
Elbow bent 90 degrees
Rotate forearm outward against resistance
Return with control

name: Band Internal Rotation
instructions: Anchor band to side at elbow height
Hold with elbow at side bent 90 degrees
Rotate forearm inward across body
Return with control

name: Band Shoulder Dislocates
instructions: Hold band wide overhead
Keeping arms straight, rotate band behind back
Continue over head to front
Use wide grip as needed for mobility

name: Band Pass Through
instructions: Hold band with wide grip at hips
Keeping arms straight, raise overhead
Continue lowering behind back
Reverse motion to return

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Hold medicine ball overhead
Slam ball down to ground with full force
Squat to pick up ball
Return to standing and repeat

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
instructions: Stand perpendicular to wall holding ball at hip
Rotate torso and throw ball at wall
Catch rebound and immediately rotate back
Repeat for reps then switch sides

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Throw
instructions: Hold ball overhead
Step forward and throw ball at wall or to partner
Use full body momentum
Catch and repeat

name: Medicine Ball Scoop Throw
instructions: Hold ball between legs in squat position
Explosively stand and throw ball up and forward
Use hip drive to generate power
Catch and repeat

name: Medicine Ball Rainbow Slam
instructions: Hold ball overhead to one side
Arc ball over head and slam to other side
Pick up and reverse the arc
Continue alternating sides

name: Medicine Ball Squat Throw
instructions: Hold ball at chest in squat position
Drive up explosively throwing ball overhead
Catch ball and immediately squat
Repeat in continuous motion

name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent holding ball at chest
Lean back slightly and lift feet if able
Rotate torso touching ball to floor each side
Keep core engaged throughout

name: Medicine Ball V-Up
instructions: Lie flat holding ball overhead
Simultaneously raise legs and torso
Touch ball to feet at top
Lower with control

name: Medicine Ball Woodchop
instructions: Hold ball overhead to one side
Chop down diagonally across body to opposite hip
Use core rotation to drive movement
Return to start and repeat

name: Medicine Ball Reverse Woodchop
instructions: Hold ball at one hip
Rotate and lift ball diagonally to opposite shoulder
Control the movement through core
Return and repeat

name: Medicine Ball Lunge Twist
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball at chest level with both hands
Step forward into a lunge position, lowering your back knee toward the ground
At the bottom of the lunge, rotate your torso toward your front leg while holding the ball
Rotate back to center and push off to return to standing
Alternate legs with each rep, rotating toward the forward leg each time

name: Medicine Ball Push Up
instructions: Place one or both hands on medicine ball in pushup position
Lower chest toward ball
Press up maintaining stability
Can alternate ball between hands each rep

name: Medicine Ball Plank
instructions: Place hands on medicine ball in plank position
Engage core and maintain straight body
Hold for desired duration
Control the instability of the ball

name: Medicine Ball Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back holding ball over chest
Lift legs with knees at 90 degrees
Lower opposite arm and leg while holding ball
Return and alternate sides

name: Medicine Ball Burpee
instructions: Stand holding ball at chest
Squat and place ball on ground
Jump feet back to plank on ball
Jump feet forward, pick up ball, and jump up

name: Medicine Ball Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Hold ball in both hands standing on one leg
Hinge forward lowering ball toward ground
Extend free leg behind for balance
Drive hips forward to return

name: Medicine Ball Situp Throw
instructions: Lie on back holding ball at chest
Sit up explosively throwing ball to partner or wall
Catch ball and lower back down
Repeat continuously

name: Medicine Ball Wall Ball
instructions: Hold ball at chest facing wall
Squat down keeping chest up
Drive up and throw ball to target on wall
Catch ball and immediately squat

name: Medicine Ball Side Throw
instructions: Stand sideways to wall holding ball at hip
Rotate hips and throw ball at wall
Catch and immediately throw again
Complete reps then switch sides

name: Medicine Ball Toe Touch
instructions: Lie on back with legs vertical holding ball
Crunch up and touch ball to toes
Lower with control
Keep legs straight throughout

name: Tuck Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart
Jump up explosively bringing knees to chest
Land softly on balls of feet
Immediately jump again

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Stand at edge of space with feet hip width
Swing arms back and bend knees
Explode forward jumping as far as possible
Land softly and reset

name: Lateral Bound
instructions: Stand on one leg
Push off laterally jumping to opposite leg
Land softly on single leg
Immediately bound back

name: Single Leg Hop
instructions: Stand on one leg
Hop forward landing on same leg
Maintain balance and immediately hop again
Complete reps then switch legs

name: Depth Jump
instructions: Stand on top of a sturdy box or platform, toes near the edge
Step off the box and land softly on both feet with knees slightly bent
Immediately upon landing, explode upward into a maximum vertical jump
Land softly with bent knees to absorb the impact
Step back onto the box and repeat for desired reps

name: Depth Jump to Broad Jump
instructions: Stand on top of a sturdy box or platform, toes near the edge
Step off the box and land softly on both feet with knees bent
Immediately upon landing, explode forward into a maximum broad jump
Land softly with bent knees and absorb the impact
Walk back to the box and repeat for desired reps

name: Split Squat Jump
instructions: Start in lunge position
Jump up explosively
Switch legs in air
Land in lunge with opposite leg forward

name: Skater Jump
instructions: Stand on one leg
Leap laterally landing on opposite foot
Swing trailing leg behind landing leg
Immediately leap to other side

name: Pogo Jump
instructions: Stand with feet together
Jump up and down using only ankles
Minimize knee bend
Focus on quick ground contact

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place driving knees high
Bring knees to hip height each step
Pump arms in running motion
Maintain quick tempo

name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Run in place kicking heels to glutes
Focus on quick leg turnover
Keep upper body stable
Maintain quick tempo

name: A-Skip
instructions: Skip forward driving one knee up high
Emphasize triple extension on push-off
Pump opposite arm with knee
Alternate legs in skipping motion

name: B-Skip
instructions: Skip with high knee drive
At top of knee drive, extend leg forward
Snap leg down and back in pawing motion
Alternate legs in skipping motion

name: Power Skip
instructions: Skip forward with exaggerated height
Drive knee up forcefully
Get maximum height on each skip
Pump arms powerfully

name: Sprint Intervals
instructions: Sprint at maximum effort for set distance
Walk or jog for recovery period
Maintain proper sprint mechanics
Repeat for desired number of intervals

name: Hill Sprints
instructions: Find hill with moderate incline
Sprint up hill at maximum effort
Walk down for recovery
Repeat for desired intervals

name: Shuttle Run
instructions: Set up markers at set distance
Sprint to marker and touch ground
Sprint back to start
Continue for desired reps

name: Speed Ladder Drills
instructions: Place agility ladder on ground
Run through ladder with quick feet
Various patterns: two feet each box, laterals, ickey shuffle
Focus on foot speed and coordination

name: Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Assume athletic stance
Shuffle sideways maintaining low position
Keep feet from touching or crossing
Shuffle back in opposite direction

name: Carioca
instructions: Move laterally crossing feet over and behind
Rotate hips while keeping shoulders square
Move quickly with arm swing
Reverse direction

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides
Jump and spread your legs shoulder-width apart while raising arms overhead
Jump again to bring feet back together and lower arms to your sides
Repeat the movement quickly and rhythmically for the desired duration
Keep your core engaged and land softly on the balls of your feet

name: Seal Jack
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms extended in front at chest height
Jump and spread your legs shoulder-width apart while opening arms out to the sides
Jump again to bring feet back together while clapping hands in front
Repeat the movement quickly and rhythmically for the desired duration
Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise

name: Clapping Push Up
instructions: Start in push up position
Lower chest to ground
Push up explosively and clap hands
Land and immediately continue

name: Medicine Ball Slam to Sprint
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball overhead
Slam the ball forcefully to the ground while hinging at the hips
Immediately after the slam, sprint forward for 10-20 meters
Walk back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps

name: Stair Sprints
instructions: Find staircase or stadium stairs
Sprint up stairs taking every step or every other
Walk down for recovery
Repeat for desired intervals

name: Battling Ropes Double Wave
instructions: Hold rope ends in each hand in athletic stance
Alternately wave arms up and down rapidly
Create continuous waves in ropes
Maintain for timed interval

name: Battling Ropes Power Slam
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, holding one rope end in each hand
Raise both arms overhead while keeping your core engaged
Slam both ropes down forcefully toward the ground
Immediately raise arms back up and repeat rapidly for the set duration

name: Battling Ropes Alternating Wave
instructions: Hold rope ends in each hand
Wave one arm up as other goes down
Create alternating waves
Maintain for timed interval

name: Jumping Rope
instructions: Hold rope handles at hip level
Swing rope overhead and jump as it passes under feet
Land on balls of feet
Maintain rhythm

name: Double Under
instructions: Swing rope fast enough to pass under feet twice per jump
Jump slightly higher than single under
Keep arms close to body
Maintain rhythm

name: Crab Walk
instructions: Sit and place hands behind, lift hips off ground
Walk forward or backward on hands and feet
Keep hips elevated throughout
Continue for distance

name: Frog Jump
instructions: Squat down with hands touching floor
Jump forward explosively like a frog
Land in deep squat position
Immediately jump again

name: 180 Jump
instructions: Start in athletic stance
Jump and rotate 180 degrees in air
Land facing opposite direction
Immediately jump and rotate back

name: 360 Jump
instructions: Start in athletic stance
Jump and rotate full 360 degrees
Land in starting position
Immediately continue

name: Pike Push Up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips high and legs straight
Place hands shoulder-width apart with fingers pointing forward
Lower the top of your head toward the ground by bending your elbows
Press back up to the starting pike position by extending your arms
Keep your core tight and hips elevated throughout the movement

name: Wall Walk
instructions: Start in push up position feet against wall
Walk feet up wall while walking hands back
Continue until in handstand position
Walk back down with control

name: Pseudo Planche Push Up
instructions: Place hands by hips with fingers pointing toward feet
Lean forward shifting weight over hands
Perform push up while maintaining forward lean
Keep elbows close to body

name: L-Sit
instructions: Place hands on floor or parallettes
Press up and lift legs horizontal
Keep legs straight and together
Hold for duration

name: Tuck Planche
instructions: Place hands on floor and lean forward
Lift feet off ground with knees tucked to chest
Balance on hands only
Hold for duration

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on bench gripping behind head
Raise entire body until vertical
Lower body keeping straight line
Only shoulders touch bench at bottom

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on back pressing lower back to floor
Raise shoulders and legs off ground
Extend arms overhead
Hold position maintaining back pressed to floor

name: Hollow Body Rock
instructions: Assume hollow body hold position
Rock forward and backward maintaining shape
Keep lower back pressed flat
Continue for reps or duration

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead
Lift arms, chest, and legs off ground
Squeeze glutes and lower back
Hold for duration

name: Reverse Plank
instructions: Sit with legs extended, hands behind hips
Press up lifting hips to form straight line
Keep arms straight and core engaged
Hold for duration

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Position yourself on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder
Place the inside of your top foot on a bench or elevated surface
Lift your hips off the ground and raise your bottom leg to meet the top foot
Hold this position with your body in a straight line, engaging your core and adductors
Switch sides and repeat

name: Spiderman Plank
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under shoulders and body in a straight line
Keeping your core tight, bring one knee toward the same side elbow
Return the leg to the starting plank position with control
Alternate sides, bringing the opposite knee to elbow
Continue alternating while maintaining a stable torso throughout

name: Up Down Plank
instructions: Start in forearm plank
Press up to high plank one arm at a time
Lower back to forearm plank one arm at a time
Alternate leading arm

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with one foot flat, other leg extended
Drive through grounded heel to lift hips
Keep hips level throughout
Lower and repeat

name: Hip Circle
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side
Make large circles with your hip, moving forward and backward
Perform circles in both directions before switching to the other leg
Keep your core engaged and hips stable throughout

name: Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side
Raise the leg until your thigh is parallel to the floor
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement
Lower with control and repeat for desired reps before switching sides

name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg behind you
Push your foot toward the ceiling while squeezing your glute
Keep your core tight and avoid arching your lower back
Lower with control and repeat for desired reps before switching sides

name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg, other leg bent behind holding foot
Squat down until rear knee touches ground
Drive through front heel to stand
Complete reps then switch legs

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel with torso upright, ankles dorsiflexed
Lean back slowly keeping hips extended
Go as far as controllable
Use quads to return to upright

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel with ankles secured
Lower torso forward slowly with control
Keep hips extended throughout
Catch yourself and push back up

name: Candlestick to Pistol
instructions: Start standing on one leg with the other leg extended in front
Roll backward onto your back while keeping the extended leg straight
Rock forward using momentum while keeping one leg extended
Use your standing leg to push up into a single-leg squat (pistol) position
Stand fully and repeat, then alternate legs for balanced training

name: Cable Woodchop High to Low
instructions: Set cable to high position
Stand sideways to machine gripping handle with both hands
Pull diagonally down across body to opposite hip
Control return and repeat

name: Cable Woodchop Low to High
instructions: Set cable to low position
Stand sideways gripping handle with both hands
Pull diagonally up across body to opposite shoulder
Control return and repeat

name: Cable Pallof Press
instructions: Set cable at chest height
Stand perpendicular holding handle at chest
Press handle straight out resisting rotation
Return to chest and repeat

name: Cable Pull Through
instructions: Set cable low and face away from machine
Reach between legs and grab rope handle
Drive hips forward pulling cable through legs
Hinge back with control and repeat

name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Set cable low holding handle at hips
Hinge forward pushing hips back
Lower until stretch in hamstrings
Drive hips forward to stand

name: Cable Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach ankle strap and stand sideways to machine
Lift outside leg away from body
Control the movement throughout
Switch sides after reps

name: Cable Reverse Lunge
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable pulley and stand facing the machine
Hold the handle with both hands at chest level and step back into a reverse lunge
Lower your back knee toward the ground while keeping your torso upright
Push through your front heel to return to standing
Alternate legs with each rep while maintaining tension on the cable

name: Cable Squat
instructions: Hold low cable handle at chest
Squat down keeping tension on cable
Drive through heels to stand
Keep chest up throughout

name: Cable Chest Press Single Arm
instructions: Set cable at chest height
Press forward with one arm while staggering stance
Return with control
Complete reps then switch arms

name: Cable High Fly
instructions: Set cables high on both sides
Step forward and bring handles down and together
Focus on lower chest contraction
Return with control

name: Cable Y Raise
instructions: Set cable low and face machine
Raise arms up in Y shape overhead
Squeeze shoulder blades at top
Lower with control

name: Cable External Rotation
instructions: Set cable at elbow height
Stand sideways holding with outside hand
Keep elbow at side and rotate forearm out
Control return and switch sides

name: Cable Internal Rotation
instructions: Set cable at elbow height
Stand sideways holding with inside hand
Keep elbow at side and rotate forearm across body
Control return and switch sides

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Set cable high and face away
Hold rope behind head with elbows bent
Extend elbows pressing hands forward and up
Return with control

name: Cable Bayesian Curl
instructions: Set cable low behind you
Hold handle with arm behind body
Curl hand toward shoulder keeping elbow back
Return with control

name: Cable Spider Curl
instructions: Set cable low and use incline bench facing back
Let arms hang down holding cable
Curl hands toward shoulders
Lower with control

name: Cable Single Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Set cable high and hold with one hand
Pull handle down to shoulder
Squeeze lat at bottom
Complete reps then switch arms

name: Cable Seated Low Row Close Grip
instructions: Sit at cable row with close grip handle
Pull handle to lower chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Extend arms with control

name: Cable Standing Row
instructions: Set cable at hip height
Stand facing machine and pull handles to sides
Squeeze shoulder blades at contraction
Return with control

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with back against bench, barbell over hips
Drive through heels to lift hips
Squeeze glutes at top
Lower with control

name: Barbell Z Press
instructions: Sit on floor with legs extended holding barbell at shoulders
Press overhead without using leg drive
Requires significant core stability
Lower with control

name: Barbell Seal Row
instructions: Lie face down on elevated bench
Arms hang down holding barbell
Row bar to bench without using momentum
Lower with control

name: Barbell Meadows Row
instructions: Set barbell in landmine or corner
Stand perpendicular and hinge forward
Row end of bar to hip with outside arm
Switch sides after reps

name: Barbell Cossack Squat
instructions: Hold barbell on back in squat position
Shift weight to one leg and squat laterally
Keep other leg straight with toe up
Return to center and alternate

name: Barbell Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on platform 2-4 inches high
Deadlift from this elevated position
Increases range of motion
Lower with control

name: Barbell Pause Deadlift
instructions: Perform deadlift with pause below knee
Hold pause for 2-3 seconds
Complete lift to lockout
Strengthens weak point

name: Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Take very wide grip on barbell
Perform deadlift with snatch grip
Greater range of motion than conventional
Lower with control

name: Barbell Jefferson Deadlift
instructions: Straddle barbell with one foot in front
Grip bar with one hand in front, one behind
Lift bar while straddling
Alternate foot position between sets

name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
instructions: Stand beside barbell and grip center
Lift barbell like picking up suitcase
Keep body from tilting to side
Lower with control

name: Barbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and feet flat
Hold the barbell at chest level with a grip slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower the bar until your triceps touch the floor, pausing briefly
Press the bar back up to full arm extension with control
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and core engaged throughout

name: Barbell Pin Press
instructions: Set the safety pins in a power rack at chest height
Position yourself under the bar and grip it slightly wider than shoulder-width
Press the bar from the pins to full lockout, squeezing at the top
Lower the bar back to the pins with control, letting it settle before the next rep
Focus on explosive power from the dead stop position

name: Barbell Spoto Press
instructions: Lower barbell to 1-2 inches above chest
Pause without touching chest
Press back to lockout
Increases time under tension

name: Barbell Larsen Press
instructions: Bench press with legs extended off floor
Eliminates leg drive
Requires greater chest and core activation
Lower and press with control

name: Barbell JM Press
instructions: Lower barbell toward chin with elbows pointing up
Hybrid of close grip press and skull crusher
Press back to lockout
Emphasizes triceps

name: Barbell Push Press
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulders in front rack
Dip knees slightly
Explosively extend legs while pressing overhead
Lower to shoulders with control

name: Barbell Behind the Neck Press
instructions: Sit or stand with a barbell resting on your upper traps behind your neck
Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width with elbows pointed down
Press the bar straight up overhead until arms are fully extended
Lower the bar back behind your neck with control
Keep your core tight and avoid excessive arching of the lower back

name: Barbell Bradford Press
instructions: Press barbell just over head
Lower behind head to upper back
Press back over head
Lower to front and repeat

name: Barbell Hang Clean
instructions: Hold barbell at hang position above knees
Explosively pull and catch in front rack
Stand to complete lift
Return to hang and repeat

name: Barbell Hang Snatch
instructions: Hold barbell at hang with snatch grip
Explosively pull and catch overhead
Stand to complete lift
Return to hang and repeat

name: Barbell Power Snatch
instructions: Start with barbell on floor snatch grip
Pull explosively and catch overhead
Catch in partial squat position
Stand to complete

name: Barbell Muscle Snatch
instructions: Hold barbell with snatch grip
Pull bar overhead without dropping under
Keep bar close to body throughout
Use arm and back strength to complete

name: Barbell High Pull
instructions: Hold barbell at hang position
Pull explosively leading with elbows
Bring bar to chin level
Lower with control

name: Barbell Cuban Rotation
instructions: Hold barbell with upright row grip
Row to chin level
Rotate forearms up until bar is overhead
Reverse movement to return

name: Barbell Rollout
instructions: Kneel holding barbell with plates on floor
Roll bar forward extending body
Keep core tight and back flat
Roll back to kneeling position

name: Barbell Landmine 180
instructions: Hold barbell end with both hands overhead
Rotate bar in arc to one hip
Rotate back overhead and to other hip
Control the movement throughout

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells together over chest
Press dumbbells together hard throughout
Lower while maintaining squeeze
Press up keeping constant pressure

name: Dumbbell Svend Press
instructions: Hold one dumbbell between palms at chest
Press outward from chest squeezing plates together
Extend arms fully
Return to chest

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on floor holding dumbbells over chest
Lower dumbbells to sides with slight elbow bend
Upper arms touch floor at bottom
Squeeze chest to bring together

name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Curl by dragging dumbbells up body
Elbows move back as you curl
Lower by dragging down body

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench
Let arms hang down holding dumbbells
Curl dumbbells toward shoulders
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Waiter Curl
instructions: Hold top of one dumbbell with both palms under plate
Curl dumbbell toward chin
Keep elbows close to body
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbells over face
Lower dumbbells by bending elbows
Keep upper arms vertical
Extend elbows to return

name: Dumbbell Y Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides or lie on incline bench
Raise arms up in Y shape
Thumbs pointing up
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Scaption
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Raise arms at 45 degree angle between front and lateral
Lead with thumbs
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Lu Raise
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at sides
Raise to lateral position with elbows bent 90 degrees
Rotate to press overhead
Reverse movement to return

name: Dumbbell High Pull
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs
Pull up explosively leading with elbows
Bring dumbbells to chin level
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Upright Row Wide Grip
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs with wide grip
Pull up along body keeping elbows wide
Bring dumbbells to shoulder level
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Kroc Row
instructions: Heavy single arm row with loose form
Use momentum to complete high reps
Focus on weight and volume over strict form
Grip strengthening exercise

name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench
Let arms hang holding dumbbells
Row dumbbells to sides
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Meadows Row
instructions: Stand perpendicular to bench with one dumbbell
Hinge forward and row dumbbell to hip
Allow slight rotation
Complete reps then switch sides

name: Dumbbell Gorilla Row
instructions: Set two dumbbells on the floor and stand over them in a wide stance
Hinge at the hips and grab the dumbbells with arms hanging straight down
Row one dumbbell up toward your hip while bracing against the other
Lower with control and immediately row the opposite side
Alternate rows while keeping your back flat and core engaged

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand wide with toes pointed out
Hold dumbbell between legs
Drive through heels to stand
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Deficit Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on platform holding dumbbells
Perform RDL with extended range of motion
Lower dumbbells past toes
Drive hips forward to return

name: Dumbbell Heels Elevated Goblet Squat
instructions: Place heels on small plates or wedge
Hold dumbbell in goblet position
Squat deep with elevated heels
Drive through feet to stand

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides in split stance
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Drive through front heel to return
Complete reps then switch legs

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step forward into lunge
Drive through front heel to step into next lunge
Continue walking for reps

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides or at chest
Step wide to one side into lateral lunge
Push back to starting position
Alternate sides

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step back and across behind standing leg
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Return to standing and alternate

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders
Squat down keeping chest up
Drive up and press dumbbells overhead
Lower to shoulders and repeat

name: Dumbbell Man Maker
instructions: Start in pushup position on dumbbells
Do pushup then row each dumbbell
Jump feet forward to squat
Stand and press overhead

name: Dumbbell Devil Press
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides
Drop to floor bringing dumbbells down
Do burpee with hands on dumbbells
Jump and swing dumbbells overhead

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean
instructions: Hold dumbbells at hang position
Explosively shrug and pull to shoulders
Catch in front rack position
Return to hang and repeat

name: Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Hold dumbbell in one hand at hip
Explosively pull dumbbell overhead
Catch with arm locked out
Lower with control

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position shoulders under pads on hack squat machine
Place feet on platform shoulder width apart
Lower by bending knees and hips
Drive through heels to return

name: Leg Press Single Leg
instructions: Sit in leg press with one foot on platform
Lower weight by bending knee
Press through foot to extend
Complete reps then switch legs

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Position in pendulum squat machine
Squat down following machine arc
Keep chest up throughout
Drive through feet to return

name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach belt to weight stack around hips
Stand on platforms with feet wide
Squat down with weight hanging from belt
Spares lower back from compression

name: Sissy Squat Machine
instructions: Lock feet and shins into machine
Lean back lowering knees toward floor
Keep hips extended throughout
Drive through quads to return

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in machine with pad above ankles
Curl heels toward glutes
Squeeze hamstrings at contraction
Return with control

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with ankles under pad
Curl heels toward glutes
Keep hips down throughout
Lower with control

name: Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Stand facing machine with ankle behind pad
Curl heel toward glutes
Squeeze hamstring at top
Lower with control and switch legs

name: Nordic Curl Machine
instructions: Kneel in machine with ankles secured
Lower torso forward with control
Keep hips extended throughout
Use hamstrings to return to upright

name: Glute Drive Machine
instructions: Sit with back against pad, feet on platform
Drive through heels to lift weight
Squeeze glutes at top
Lower with control

name: Adductor Machine
instructions: Sit with legs spread on pads
Squeeze legs together against resistance
Control the negative portion
Return to starting position

name: Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit with legs together on pads
Push legs apart against resistance
Squeeze glutes at full spread
Return with control

name: Reverse Hyper
instructions: Lie face down on reverse hyper machine
Hold handles and swing legs back and up
Squeeze glutes at top
Lower with control

name: Back Extension Machine
instructions: Position in back extension with pad at hips
Lower torso toward floor
Raise torso to horizontal or slightly above
Control the movement throughout

name: Chest Press Machine
instructions: Sit in machine with handles at chest level
Press handles forward until arms extended
Return with control
Keep shoulder blades squeezed

name: Incline Chest Press Machine
instructions: Sit in incline press machine
Press handles up and forward
Focus on upper chest contraction
Return with control

name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Sit with arms on pads at chest level
Squeeze arms together in front of chest
Hold contraction briefly
Return with control

name: Cable Machine Row
instructions: Sit at row machine with feet on platform
Pull handle to torso
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Extend arms with control

name: Lat Pulldown Machine
instructions: Sit at lat pulldown with thighs secured
Pull bar to upper chest
Squeeze lats at bottom
Extend arms with control

name: Low Row Machine
instructions: Sit at chest-supported low row
Pull handles to sides
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Return with control

name: Shoulder Press Machine
instructions: Sit in shoulder press with handles at shoulders
Press handles overhead
Lower with control
Keep core engaged

name: Lateral Raise Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat height so the pads rest against your upper arms
Sit upright with your back against the pad and grip the handles
Raise your arms out to the sides by pushing against the pads until parallel to the floor
Squeeze at the top of the movement and hold briefly
Lower with control back to the starting position

name: Rear Delt Machine
instructions: Sit facing pad with handles in front
Pull handles back in reverse fly motion
Squeeze rear delts at contraction
Return with control

name: Preacher Curl Machine
instructions: Sit with arms on preacher pad
Curl handles toward shoulders
Squeeze biceps at top
Lower with control

name: Tricep Dip Machine
instructions: Sit in dip machine with hands on handles
Press handles down extending elbows
Control the negative
Return to start

name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Sit in machine with pad at chest
Crunch forward against resistance
Control the contraction
Return with control

name: Rotary Torso Machine
instructions: Sit in machine with chest against pad
Rotate torso to one side against resistance
Control the rotation
Return and rotate to other side

name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
instructions: Support yourself on arm pads with back against support
Raise knees toward chest
Control the movement
Lower with control

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Position under Smith machine bar on shoulders
Place feet slightly forward
Squat down keeping back against bar
Drive through heels to return

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with back against bench, bar over hips
Drive through heels to lift hips
Squeeze glutes at top
Lower with control

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar at hips in Smith machine
Hinge forward pushing hips back
Lower until stretch in hamstrings
Drive hips forward to return

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
instructions: Set bench at incline under Smith machine
Lower bar to upper chest
Press bar to lockout
Lower with control

name: Smith Machine Overhead Press
instructions: Sit or stand under Smith machine
Press bar from shoulders to lockout
Lower to shoulders with control
Keep core engaged

name: Assisted Pull Up Machine
instructions: Kneel on platform and grip handles overhead
Pull body up with assistance from platform
Lower with control
Reduce assistance as strength improves

name: Assisted Dip Machine
instructions: Kneel on platform and grip dip handles
Lower body with assistance from platform
Press up to straighten arms
Reduce assistance as strength improves

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Start in lunge position with hands on floor
Rotate torso opening one arm to ceiling
Hold and return hand to floor
Step forward and repeat on other side

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg in front at 90 degrees, other at side at 90 degrees
Keep both knees at 90 degree angles
Lean forward over front shin
Hold and switch sides

name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel with one foot elevated behind on couch or bench
Drive hips forward feeling stretch in hip flexor and quad
Keep torso upright
Hold and switch sides

name: Bretzel Stretch
instructions: Lie on side with top leg bent at hip
Grab ankle of bottom leg behind you
Rotate torso toward ceiling
Hold breathing deeply

name: Thread the Needle
instructions: Start on all fours
Thread one arm under body reaching across
Lower shoulder to floor
Hold and repeat other side

name: Open Book Stretch
instructions: Lie on side with knees bent and arms extended
Rotate top arm and torso opening like a book
Keep knees together
Return and repeat

name: Scorpion Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with arms out to sides
Kick one leg up and across body toward opposite hand
Allow hips to rotate
Return and alternate sides

name: Wall Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel in lunge with rear foot against wall
Drive hips forward
Increase stretch by squeezing glute
Hold and switch sides

name: Frog Stretch
instructions: Start on all fours and widen knees as far as possible
Turn feet out with inside of feet on floor
Sink hips back and down
Hold feeling stretch in groin

name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit with soles of feet together
Hold ankles and let knees fall open
Gently press knees down with elbows
Hold stretching inner thighs

name: Seated Figure Four
instructions: Sit in chair with one ankle crossed over opposite knee
Gently press down on raised knee
Lean forward slightly for deeper stretch
Hold and switch sides

name: Lying Figure Four
instructions: Lie on back with one ankle crossed over opposite knee
Pull bottom leg toward chest
Feel stretch in glute of crossed leg
Hold and switch sides

name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand tall on one leg, using a wall or chair for balance if needed
Bend your other knee and grab your ankle behind you
Gently pull your heel toward your glute while keeping your knees together
Keep your standing leg slightly bent and pelvis tucked
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your quadriceps, then switch sides

name: Lying Quad Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and head resting on your arm
Bend your top knee and grab your ankle with your top hand
Gently pull your heel toward your glute while keeping hips stacked
Avoid rotating your pelvis or arching your back
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Place one heel on elevated surface
Keep leg straight and hinge at hips
Reach toward toes
Hold and switch legs

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended, other foot to inner thigh
Reach toward extended foot
Keep back as straight as possible
Hold and switch legs

name: Wall Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand in doorway with forearm on wall
Step forward stretching chest
Adjust arm height to target different chest fibers
Hold and switch sides

name: Cross Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Bring one arm across body at shoulder height
Use opposite hand to pull arm closer
Feel stretch in rear shoulder
Hold and switch sides

name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend elbow
Use opposite hand to gently push elbow back
Feel stretch in triceps
Hold and switch arms

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
instructions: Extend arm with palm up
Use opposite hand to pull fingers back toward body
Feel stretch in forearm
Hold and switch arms

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
instructions: Extend arm with palm down
Use opposite hand to pull hand down
Feel stretch in top of forearm
Hold and switch arms

name: Neck Circles
instructions: Stand or sit with good posture
Slowly circle head in one direction
Make controlled, deliberate movements
Reverse direction

name: Neck Side Bend
instructions: Stand or sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position
Slowly tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds while breathing normally
Return to center and then tilt to the opposite side
Avoid rotating your head or lifting your shoulders during the stretch

name: Thoracic Extension Over Roller
instructions: Lie on foam roller placed across upper back
Support head with hands
Extend backward over roller
Move roller to different vertebrae and repeat

name: Cat Stretch
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Exhale as you round your spine toward the ceiling like an arching cat
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly button toward your spine
Hold the rounded position for a breath, feeling the stretch through your back
Return to neutral and repeat for desired reps

name: Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Inhale as you drop your belly toward the floor, arching your back
Lift your head and tailbone toward the ceiling
Draw your shoulder blades together and open your chest
Hold for a breath, then return to neutral and repeat

name: Prone Press Up
instructions: Lie face down with hands by shoulders
Press upper body up keeping hips down
Extend spine into extension
Hold briefly and lower

name: Supine Twist
instructions: Lie on back with arms out
Drop both knees to one side
Keep shoulders flat on floor
Hold and switch sides

name: Seated Twist
instructions: Sit with one leg extended, other foot outside opposite knee
Rotate torso toward bent knee
Use opposite elbow against knee for leverage
Hold and switch sides

name: Rocking Hip Circles
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
Keeping your arms stable, begin making circles with your hips
Move forward, to the side, back, and around in a smooth circular motion
Perform circles in one direction, then reverse
Keep your core engaged and movements controlled throughout

name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Squat down as deep as possible
Hold at bottom with elbows inside knees
Gently push knees out
Hold for extended time

name: Cossack Squat Stretch
instructions: Stand wide and shift weight to one side
Squat on one leg keeping other straight
Hold at bottom stretching adductor
Rise and switch sides

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel in lunge position
Drive hips forward keeping torso upright
Feel stretch in hip flexor of rear leg
Hold and switch sides

name: Standing Groin Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart
Shift weight to one side bending that knee
Keep other leg straight
Hold and switch sides

name: Toe Touch Progression
instructions: Stand with feet together
Fold forward reaching toward toes
Let head and arms hang
Hold feeling stretch in hamstrings and back

name: Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand on platform holding light weight
Roll spine forward one vertebra at a time
Reach past toes letting weight hang
Roll back up reversing movement

name: Active Hang
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended
Engage your shoulders by pulling them down and back (depressing the scapulae)
Keep your core tight and legs straight or slightly forward
Hold this engaged position while breathing steadily
Maintain the hold for 20-60 seconds or as long as you can with good form

name: Passive Hang
instructions: Grasp an overhead bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart
Let your body hang completely relaxed with arms fully extended
Allow your body weight to naturally decompress your spine
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply and steadily
Hold for 30-60 seconds or as long as comfortable

name: Shoulder Circles
instructions: Stand with arms relaxed at sides
Circle shoulders forward
Make large, deliberate movements
Reverse direction

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Extend arms to sides at shoulder height
Make small circles gradually increasing size
Reverse direction
Bring arms forward and repeat

name: Wall Angels
instructions: Stand with back against wall
Press arms against wall in goalpost position
Slide arms up and down wall
Keep back, elbows, and wrists touching wall

name: Band Shoulder Dislocate
instructions: Hold band wide with arms in front
Keeping arms straight, raise overhead and behind
Continue full rotation back to front
Narrow grip as flexibility improves

name: Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Lie on side with bottom arm extended
Bend elbow to 90 degrees
Use top hand to push forearm toward floor
Feel stretch in back of shoulder
